reason: User clarified on 2026-10-17, before deep model evaluation, that stops are previous lows for longs and previous highs for shorts.
status: Appendix to the unchanged frozen base protocol. No fitting or threshold selection using stop outcomes.
policies: Most recent 15min pivot with 2 bars each side, only after 2 right bars close; maximum pivot age24h
entry: Next bar open proxy, fixed initial stop, no trailing. Exclude a stop already beyond entry as invalid; report coverage and stop distance.
order: First target versus stop within24/72h; simultaneous same15min bar is stop-first and separately counted. Stop gap uses worse of stop and bar open. No assumptions about intrabar trajectory.
execution: Trade-price trigger assumed, not mark-price trigger. Funding attributed through exit bar conservatively; exact within-bar funding order unavailable.10/20bps roundtrip costs are sensitivity assumptions, not measured fills. No leverage or margin liquidation model.
comparison: Apply identical stop policies to every frozen model and both baselines, keep5/10% targets. Report all results and walk-forward folds, not only the best. Per-alert returns are overlapping hypothetical positions, not portfolio returns.
